premise.claim: A failed Pod List request during reconciliation of a StatefulSet-backed role can cause the controller to silently apply spec.replicas: 0, even though the role still requests four replicas. (issue #539)
premise.evidence: base (4a0765f7): reconcile returned nil and live STS went 5 -> 0 replicas; head (cf4bff4c): error propagated, replicas stayed 5. See results/base-envtest.out and results/base-unit.out.

integration.cmd: KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="$([ -x bin/setup-envtest ] && bin/setup-envtest use 1.31.0 --bin-dir bin -p path || setup-envtest use 1.31.0 -p path)" go test -mod=vendor -tags=envtest_verify ./pkg/reconciler -run '^TestVerifyStatefulSetNotScaledToZeroOnPodListError$' -count=1 -timeout=180s -json

liveNote: L3 skipped per review instructions (no KUBECONFIG layer). The deleted-pods effect of the zero-replica write needs a native StatefulSet controller, which envtest does not run; the API-server-persisted replicas=0 write is the verified boundary.
